scripts.dev: concurrently -n "DB,BE,FE" -c "yellow,blue,green" "npm run dev:db" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:monitoring: docker compose --profile monitoring up -d prometheus grafana
scripts.build: npm -w frontend run build && npm -w @news-portal/types run build && npm -w backend run build
scripts.lint: npm -w frontend run lint && npm -w backend run lint
scripts.test: npm -w backend run test && npm -w frontend run test && npm -w frontend-next run test:ci && npm -w frontend-nuxt run test:ci && npm -w frontend-vue run test:ci
scripts.format: npm -w frontend run format && npm -w backend run format
scripts.format:check: npm -w frontend run format:check && npm -w backend run format:check
